# Save as: .github/workflows/visitor-counter.yml
# in your Venombolteop/Venombolteop profile repo.
#
# This runs every 6 hours (and on manual trigger), fetches real GitHub
# traffic data for this repo, adds it to a running total stored in
# .github/view_count.txt, and updates the counter badge in README.md.

name: Update Visitor Counter

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 */6 * * *"   # every 6 hours
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update-counter:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Fetch traffic data and update counter
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          bash .github/scripts/update_counter.sh

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .github/view_count.txt README.md
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "chore: update visitor counter [skip ci]"
          git push
